description: Reviewed exceptions to the observation-level MCP/SKILLS layer route check (check_layer_routes.py). EXEMPT: the observation is not about what that layer returns. KNOWN_OPEN: a real gap with a named owner; ./verify prepare lists it and the coverage assembler keeps the observation NOT_RUN until the owner closes it and deletes the entry. An entry that no longer matches a gap fails the check.

entries.reason: Reads the independent host model-gate inputs (catalog oracle, R8 status, model plan). The oracle MCP layer is exercised by actual-runtime-observation through runtime-mcp in the same subcase; an MCP business read cannot prove the model gate separation.
No linked assertion reads skill-loading evidence (a skillLoading/loading/referenceReads stage or a skills/skill_loading_trace coverage row), so the observation has no SKILLS-layer evidence.
entries.closeWhen: A linked T20 assertion reads the skill-loading stage of the host or agent result, and check_layer_routes.py reports no gap.

entries.reason: host-malicious-document reads toolCalls counts and unchanged DB rows but no skill-loading stage, so the document-versus-skill authority is not observed on the SKILLS layer.
entries.closeWhen: A linked T20 assertion reads the skill-loading stage of the host or agent result, and check_layer_routes.py reports no gap.
